statements.status_notes: Backported upstream fix (commit f8a23425b, released in nginx 1.31.7) onto 1.25.5. See build/patches/CVE-2026-15176.patch and poc/prove-cve-2026-15176.sh. Scanners still flag it because the version string is still 1.25.5 — this statement tells them it is fixed in the source.

statements.impact_statement: The vulnerable reserved-area allocation in ngx_http_script_run() was introduced after 1.25.5 (commits b76754049 and a8289aa69, 2026-07-15). 1.25.5 uses the simpler allocation and is not affected.
CVE-2025-27587 affects OpenSSL only on the PowerPC architecture. This image runs on amd64, so the vulnerable code path is never executed.

HTTP/2 rapid reset. nginx 1.25.3 added a mitigation (CHANGES 1.25.3: improved detection of misbehaving clients when using HTTP/2): new streams handled per read-handler iteration are limited to 2 * http2_max_concurrent_streams (h2c->new_streams in src/http/v2/ngx_http_v2.c). 1.25.5 contains it.

The bug is in MiniZip (zipOpenNewFileInZip4_64), which Debian ships in a separate package, libminizip1. In this image zlib1g contains only libz.so.1; libminizip1 is not installed and no MiniZip file exists.
